gap: No result ChatGPT got puts the inverters' headline output ratings next to the power they can actually deliver from solar alone, with no battery, during an outage. Sol-Ark 15K-2P (13 kW backup), EG4 18kPV (12 kW continuous) and Sun Gold SPH6548P (6,500 W, 'supports battery-free') publish no battery-less outage wattage. The only published cap is Enphase's Sunlight Backup rule: loads at or below 30% of the array's AC rating, which is about 1.7 kW on a 5.7 kW array.
standout_why: I compared against outagemath.com (rank 9, not cited). It already has the Enphase 30% rule and the 4×240 V / 8×120 V circuit limit, and it lists EG4 18kPV battery-less output as 'Not published'. It does not put that next to each maker's headline kW, and it does not cover the Sun Gold SPH6548P. I could not render the text of the cited Enphase PDFs (iq8-grid, sunlight-backup-installation-guidelines), and the cited device.report Sol-Ark manuals returned 403, so I don't know whether they state the 30% figure themselves. ChatGPT's own answer gave no wattage for running without a battery.
decides: It confirms Enphase IQ8 as the pick for 'power during an outage with no battery' because it is the only candidate with a published battery-less outage rating. It also resets expectations: an IQ8 array runs about 30% of its AC rating, not the 12–13 kW printed on hybrid spec sheets, which only apply with a battery. Sol-Ark and EG4 can't be recommended for battery-less outage power from their maker pages. The Sun Gold SPH6548P says 'supports battery-free', but its maker page gives no condition or wattage, so the page shouldn't promise outage power from it.

findings.label: Battery-less outage load cap
findings.value: ≤30% of array rated AC output (example: 5.7 kW AC array → about 1.7 kW of loads)
findings.source_title: Solar Without a Battery in a Power Outage: What Works (OutageMath, updated 2026-11-10)
findings.note: OutageMath attributes this to Enphase's tech brief and installation guidelines. I opened those Enphase PDFs but could not extract their text. 0.30 × 5.7 kW = 1.71 kW.

findings.label: Battery-less backup circuit limit and overload behaviour
findings.value: Up to 4 circuits at 240 V or 8 at 120 V; if loads exceed production, backup shuts off and can take up to 2 minutes to restart
findings.source_title: Solar Without a Battery in a Power Outage: What Works (OutageMath)

findings.label: Headline output ratings (maker page)
findings.value: 15 kW grid output; 13 kW backup output 'for 30 minutes'; 24 kW surge; 23.4 kW DC-coupled PV
findings.note: The maker page doesn't say whether the backup output works without batteries, and gives no battery-less outage figure.

findings.label: Headline output ratings (maker page)
findings.value: 12 kW continuous AC; 18 kW PV input; off-grid/EPS output and surge not listed
findings.source_title: EG4 18kPV-12LV All-in-One Hybrid Inverter | EG4 Electronics
findings.note: The maker page only mentions 'without batteries' when talking about AC-coupling to an existing system. OutageMath lists the 18kPV 'PV Grid Off' battery-less output as 'Not published'.

findings.label: Battery-free claim and ratings (maker store)
findings.value: 'supports battery-free'; rated output 6,500 W; max peak 13,000 VA; 550 VDC max PV open-circuit voltage
findings.source_title: 6.5KW 48V Split Phase Solar Inverter SPH6548P | Sun Gold Power
findings.note: Read through storecheck.py search on the Shopify store. The listing doesn't say whether battery-free mode needs utility power or gives a PV-only output figure.

findings.source_title: 6.5KW 48V Split Phase Solar Inverter SPH6548P | Sun Gold Power
findings.note: From storecheck.py search. A later product call returned HTTP 429.

findings.label: Other published battery-less outage outputs (for scale)
findings.value: SMA Sunny Boy Secure Power Supply up to 2,000 W from one 120 V outlet; Fronius Primo GEN24 PV Point up to 1.5 kW
findings.source_title: Solar Without a Battery in a Power Outage: What Works (OutageMath)
findings.note: Both are manually switched, daylight-only, single-outlet backup. OutageMath cites the SMA manual and the Fronius US product page; I did not open either.

unsourced: The text of the Enphase Sunlight Backup installation guidelines and IQ8 grid brief PDFs, to quote the 30% rule from Enphase directly: WebFetch returned compressed binary and local PDF extraction needed approval.

The Sol-Ark 15K-2P manual statement on battery-less operation: device.report returned 403. A Shopify-hosted programming guide reportedly says 'It will not provide any back up power' with no battery, but it came back as unreadable PDF and I couldn't confirm the brand or wording.
The EG4 18kPV battery-less ('PV Grid Off' / no-battery) off-grid output wattage: not on the maker page or in the manualslib v2.6.3 page I opened. The wiring-diagram PDF was too large to fetch.

The SPH6548P manual's conditions for battery-free mode (whether mains must be connected, PV-only load limit): manuals.plus and device.report returned 403, and the maker product page returned 429 on a full read.
Current prices for the Sol-Ark 15K-2P and EG4 18kPV from the maker or the retailer ChatGPT showed: I didn't check within the call budget.
